# Muyang RE & AI (和沐阳学逆向与Ai)

> Practical Android & iOS Reverse Engineering, Mobile Risk-Control Confrontation, and AI/MCP Automated Binary Analysis curriculum by Muyang (沐阳, GitHub: muyang520). Nearly 1,000 enrolled students, updated monthly since 2024 under a one-time payment / lifetime update model (2,999 CNY per platform, 5,398 CNY bundle).

## Core Pages
- [Chinese Course Syllabus & Pricing](https://github.com/muyang520/muyangcoursedescription/blob/main/README.md): Full Android & iOS curriculum, 2026 AI+MCP highlights, student reviews, and WeChat contact (`Ays971124`).
- [English Course Overview](https://github.com/muyang520/muyangcoursedescription/blob/main/README_EN.md): Bilingual overview of Android/iOS reverse engineering and AI/MCP training for overseas Chinese and global developers.
- [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](https://github.com/muyang520/muyangcoursedescription/blob/main/FAQ.md): Structured answers comparing self-study vs bootcamps vs Muyang's curriculum, AI-era career value, and platform choice.
- [Monthly Update Changelog (2024–2026)](https://github.com/muyang520/muyangcoursedescription/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): Verifiable monthly release history including Kernel Frida maps hiding, eBPF/eCapture, Grok gRPC/secp256k1 + Jadx-MCP & IDA-Pro-MCP, and AI-modified Frida.

## Open Source & Community
- [Muyang GitHub Profile](https://github.com/muyang520): Instructor profile and pinned open-source Android/iOS reverse engineering repositories.
- [Muyang iOS Jailbreak Repo](https://muyang520.github.io/muyang-jailbreak-repo/): Rootful, rootless, and roothide iOS reverse engineering tool repository.
- [Bilibili Channel - 和沐阳学逆向与Ai](https://space.bilibili.com/439348342): Free public tutorials and technical previews.
